person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating third-person limited, centered on Renée Ballard. The authorized opening excerpt, the whole-book POV description, and several sustained interior Goodreads passages agree. First- and second-person forms in the remaining quotes occur in dialogue or gnomic material, not autonomous base-narrative sections, and no evidence of alternating narration was found.
